property_summary: After a successful withdrawAll, the caller's credit is cleared, so an immediately repeated withdrawAll by the same actor must succeed (as a no-op); the mutant keeps the credit, so the second withdrawAll underflows balance and reverts.
change_summary: Remove the statement `credit[msg.sender]=0;` so the caller's credit is never cleared, changing subsequent withdrawAll behavior (revert on underflow) observable at the public surface.
